question: For this conflicting ClawSweeper replacement, should OpenClaw accept focused runner/Codex regression proof after a clean refresh, or require live wedged Codex app-server proof before merge?
rationale: The code path and regression are coherent, but the branch conflicts with current main and the PR already carries a human-review/proof-decision pause.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused regression as sufficient for the runner-owned lane-release contract.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until Crabbox or live evidence shows a stuck Codex app-server cleanup no longer blocks later same-session work.

options.title: Close The Replacement
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want to pursue the Codex lane-release repair from the replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused regression as sufficient for the runner-owned lane-release contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent current-main Codex app-server refactor that this PR must be reconciled with.
